en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the woman who menstruates and she is with sexual impurity. Is there a major ablution (from sexual impurity) upon her?’ Heasws said: ‘The major ablution (for sexual impurity) and (for) the menstruation (Haydh), is one’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a woman who experiences Hayd (menses) when she has had sexual relation if she needed Ghusl (bath) because of sexual relation.
He (the Imam) said, ‘Ghusl (bath) for Hayd (menses) and sexual relation is one.’”
